A '''jammer''' was a device used to scramble communications. Existing in various forms and size, it could be used on its own or installed on a spacecrafts, like on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]], and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]], or even on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], like the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]. It could range from a small area, like a town,<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Clearing the Air|Ord Mantell}}</ref> to a whole planet. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] used a jamming device to effectively stop communication on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Jamming devices however, had the habit of cutting off all major and minor communications inside the ship on which the jammers was installed, as well as jamming the enemy, making them very reliant on other ships. Essentially, it also jammed comlinks inside of ships and could jam scanners. The only mean to counter its effect was to disable the device.<ref name="TOR" />
